relations: Dante 是 Ophelia 的 mate，本章他的视角；自称从监狱初见那刻就想要她。
Ophelia 就是 penitentiary 的建造者——当年为自保建狱的十七岁少女；River 当年向所有被不公关押者如此介绍并要他们怪他而非她。
Redd 是 dragon shifter，曾因餐点做错失控、几分钟杀上百不死人，连 Merrily 都取不了他性命。
Jazz 上周陪 Dante 出席慈善晚宴，与 River 被仰慕者围住提前离场；她自称 fallen，他称 dark angel——你不是坠落是跳下去的。

facts.fact: 饥饿的 Ophelia 走向冰箱，Dante 问她在干什么并坚持带她去吃早餐，她拒绝。
facts.anchor: "What are you doing?" I asked, as she reached the fridge.

facts.fact: Dante 打开餐厅网页把手机塞进她手里，大步走回衣帽间。
facts.anchor: I pulled up the page for the restaurant and put my phone in her hand before striding back to the closet.

facts.fact: Ophelia 翻看餐厅内景照，问华夫饼是否真如照片。
facts.anchor: "Do the waffles really look like that?" she asked, finally looking at me.

facts.fact: 她警告这招只会有效一次，却先一步走向车。
facts.anchor: "This will only work once," she warned, already making her way to the car

facts.fact: 车行两分钟 Dante 才开口反驳指控——她曾说他在过去一个月强迫她适应他的生活方式。
facts.anchor: "You said I spent the last month forcing you to adapt to my lifestyle," I said.

facts.fact: Dante 澄清房子早在搬她入住前就过户到她名下，是当初一起办事的事项之一。
facts.anchor: You own it, Ophelia. I put it in your name before I moved you in.

facts.fact: Redd 例证：因餐点做错失控，几分钟杀上百不死人，Merrily 都取不了他性命。
facts.anchor: He lost his temper and killed over a hundred immortals in a matter of minutes, because someone made his food wrong.

facts.fact: Dante 转述 River 的狱中介绍：监狱出自十七岁少女的自保之举，众人该怪他而非她。
facts.anchor: the prison had been created by a seventeen-year-old girl who was trying to protect herself when no one else would
